# NEW 2026-11-23 v21.0 Step 5 / P1: 5 Strategic Goods Economic Loop Closure, Cross-Module Vertical Integration & 6 Native Situation GUIs (oe_sy2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v210_p1_synergy_gui.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Exported O(1) zero-slot yearly dispatcher hook (for oe_gk_yearly_dispatch).
# Self-deduplicates via global_var:oe_sy2_ran_y ?= current_year so it never double-fires.
# Strictly read-only on all sibling module variables & modifiers.
oe_sy2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_sy2_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sy2_ran_y value = current_year }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_sy2_eligible_host = yes
			}
			oe_sy2_dispatch_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Replenishes food in up to 4 strained or cold-affected provinces.
oe_sy2_refill_winter_provinces = {
	custom_tooltip = oe_sy2_refill_winter_provinces_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		ordered_province = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_starving = yes
					province_food_percentage < 0.75
				}
			}
			order_by = {
				value = 1
				subtract = province_food_percentage
			}
			max = 4
			check_range_bounds = no
			change_province_food_percentage = 0.35
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Promotes peasant pops into skilled laborers & burghers in up to 2 urban hubs.
oe_sy2_promote_skilled_urban_pops = {
	custom_tooltip = oe_sy2_promote_skilled_urban_pops_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_rank ?= location_rank:town
					location_rank ?= location_rank:city
					location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
				}
				any_pop = { pop_type = pop_type:peasants }
			}
			order_by = development
			max = 2
			check_range_bounds = no
			random_pop = {
				limit = { pop_type = pop_type:peasants }
				change_pop_type = pop_type:laborers
			}
			if = {
				limit = { any_pop = { pop_type = pop_type:peasants } }
				random_pop = {
					limit = { pop_type = pop_type:peasants }
					change_pop_type = pop_type:burghers
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_sy2_dispatch_country = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_sy2_ev_1_done }
			oe_sy2_ev1_eligible = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_sy2_ev_1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sy2.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_sy2_ev_2_done }
